comments.author: Fershte
comments.body_html:
If you wanna recost everything, that’s on you. Here’s what you would need to change:

in armalite-reloaded/db/assort.json

the costs are stored in the “barter_scheme” JSON object. for example,

“M855Bullet”: [

[{

“count”: 1,

“_tpl”: “5696686a4bdc2da3298b456a”

}]

],

count refers to the number of the desired currency,

_tpl is the currency itself. 5696686a4bdc2da3298b456a is dollars.

change it to 5449016a4bdc2d6f028b456f for roubles.

But yeah, there’s over 800 items in the shop, all costed at 108% of their resale value, if you want to change it that’s entirely up to you lol.
